environment.cotenancy: Only this order CDC pipeline; no other heavy lab.

limits: Sample-window deltas exclude startup and exit outside observation. Decreasing counters are treated as restarts and the new counter is accumulated; reset intervals have no CPU utilization estimate.
Short-lived actors may be missed; use native pre-exit cgroup counters as well.
CPU utilization is interval-average percent of one core; short spikes may be missed.
Docker disk bytes are not device I/O latency; absent counters are unavailable, not zero.

rows.scope: non-atomic owned-volume snapshot, no shared-filesystem double count

limitations: Single Docker VM; no independent-host or power-loss proof.
Spark local[1] is a bounded historical recomputation, not Spark cluster capacity.
Separate sink transactions; no atomic publication across both tables.
CSV reference compression is not native database compression; native ZSTD ratio is unavailable.
Docker observations omit some startup/exit tails, short actors and host/build costs; do not sum overlapping counters.
Observer records initial container StartedAt only; restart attribution uses native fault evidence and counter-reset detection, not complete per-epoch sampling.
Physical disk service latency/cold-cache behavior and hard-delete/backfill races remain unrun.
